parole.significato: cotton (fiber harvested from a plant of the genus Gossypium; textile made from this)
parole.testo: Inherited from Old Ruthenian ба́вовна (bávovna), ба́волна (bávolna), borrowed from Czech bavlna. Partial calque of German Baumwolle. parole.significato: political dominion, political power, right to rule
parole.testo: Borrowed from Czech vláda (a calque of German Regierung).
Borrowed from Czech časopis, calqued from German Zeitschrift. Doublet of літо́пис (litópys) and хроно́граф (xronóhraf).
